title: 隧道收斂量測
summary: 本課聚焦用多方向位移、量測基準與支護時序辨識隧道收斂機制。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on identify convergence mechanisms through multidirectional movement, survey references and support timing. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「收斂弦長與方向」與「初始讀值與已發生變形」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Convergence chords and direction" and "Initial readings and prior movement": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 收斂弦長與方向：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Convergence chords and direction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「收斂弦長與方向」如何影響隧道收斂量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Convergence chords and direction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel convergence monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 收斂弦量到兩點間距變化，不等於每點的絕對位移。水平弦縮短可能來自側壁內移或整個斷面轉動，只有加入垂直、斜向弦與坐標才能分辨對稱擠壓及偏壓。 假設原弦長8.000 m、後為7.988 m，收斂12 mm、相對應變12/8000=0.0015。 兩端測釘一起平移時弦長不變，卻可能已發生整體偏移；測釘局部鬆脫又可製造假收斂，若沒有絕對坐標便難以辨別兩者。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「收斂弦長與方向」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A convergence chord measures separation change, not absolute movement at either endpoint. Horizontal shortening may reflect inward movement or section rotation; vertical and diagonal chords plus coordinates distinguish symmetric squeezing from asymmetric loading. An assumed chord shortening from 8.000 to 7.988 m gives convergence 12 mm and relative strain 12/8000=0.0015. Both targets can translate together with unchanged chord length despite substantial section movement. A loose target can instead create false convergence, difficult to distinguish without independent coordinates. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Convergence chords and direction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩點間弦長不變就證明兩個測點都沒有移動。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An unchanged chord proves that neither of its endpoints has moved." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「收斂弦長與方向」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Convergence chords and direction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 收斂弦長與方向
knowledge.text: 收斂弦量到兩點間距變化，不等於每點的絕對位移。水平弦縮短可能來自側壁內移或整個斷面轉動，只有加入垂直、斜向弦與坐標才能分辨對稱擠壓及偏壓。
knowledge.textEn: A convergence chord measures separation change, not absolute movement at either endpoint. Horizontal shortening may reflect inward movement or section rotation; vertical and diagonal chords plus coordinates distinguish symmetric squeezing from asymmetric loading.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩點間弦長不變就證明兩個測點都沒有移動。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An unchanged chord proves that neither of its endpoints has moved. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「隧道收斂量測」的「收斂弦長與方向：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出地層、地下水、開挖邊界與支撐的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「地下水與沉陷觀測室」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與地質假設、監測位置、時間順序及基準點版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Convergence chords and direction: mechanism and system paths” in “Tunnel convergence monitoring”. Draw the ground, groundwater, excavation boundary and support interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Groundwater and settlement observatory” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ground assumptions, monitoring locations, time order and benchmark version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「收斂弦長與方向」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Convergence chords and direction" is correct?
options: 兩點間弦長不變就證明兩個測點都沒有移動。
收斂弦量到兩點間距變化，不等於每點的絕對位移。
較晚安裝的測點記錄較小收斂，就表示該斷面更穩定。
optionsEn: An unchanged chord proves that neither of its endpoints has moved.
A convergence chord measures separation change, not absolute movement at either endpoint.
Smaller convergence at a later-installed section proves that section is more stable.
quiz.explanation: 收斂弦量到兩點間距變化，不等於每點的絕對位移。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A convergence chord measures separation change, not absolute movement at either endpoint. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 收斂弦長與方向：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Convergence chords and direction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「收斂弦長與方向」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Convergence chords and direction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設原弦長8.000 m、後為7.988 m，收斂12 mm、相對應變12/8000=0.0015。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed chord shortening from 8.000 to 7.988 m gives convergence 12 mm and relative strain 12/8000=0.0015. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用多條不共線弦與全測站坐標同時檢查，核對測釘是否牢固連到代表性支護；依設計預測方向比較位移向量，不用單一水平弦直接判定整個斷面均勻收縮。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare several noncollinear chords with total-station coordinates and check that targets represent stable support locations; compare vectors with predicted directions rather than inferring uniform section shrinkage from one horizontal chord.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設原弦長8.000 m、後為7.988 m，收斂12 mm、相對應變12/8000=0.0015。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed chord shortening from 8.000 to 7.988 m gives convergence 12 mm and relative strain 12/8000=0.0015.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「收斂弦長與方向」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Convergence chords and direction", which statement holds?
options: 鋼尺讀值變化只能是圍岩變形，不會受溫度和張力影響。
收斂對時間增加必定代表潛變，與掌子面推進無關。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: A steel-tape reading changes only with ground movement, never temperature or tension.
Increasing convergence with time necessarily indicates creep unrelated to face advance.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 收斂弦長與方向：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Convergence chords and direction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「收斂弦長與方向」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Convergence chords and direction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用多條不共線弦與全測站坐標同時檢查，核對測釘是否牢固連到代表性支護；依設計預測方向比較位移向量，不用單一水平弦直接判定整個斷面均勻收縮。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：兩端測釘一起平移時弦長不變，卻可能已發生整體偏移；測釘局部鬆脫又可製造假收斂，若沒有絕對坐標便難以辨別兩者。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare several noncollinear chords with total-station coordinates and check that targets represent stable support locations; compare vectors with predicted directions rather than inferring uniform section shrinkage from one horizontal chord. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Both targets can translate together with unchanged chord length despite substantial section movement. A loose target can instead create false convergence, difficult to distinguish without independent coordinates. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄收斂弦長與方向的資料來源與適用條件。用多條不共線弦與全測站坐標同時檢查，核對測釘是否牢固連到代表性支護；依設計預測方向比較位移向量，不用單一水平弦直接判定整個斷面均勻收縮。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for convergence chords and direction. Compare several noncollinear chords with total-station coordinates and check that targets represent stable support locations; compare vectors with predicted directions rather than inferring uniform section shrinkage from one horizontal chord.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：兩端測釘一起平移時弦長不變，卻可能已發生整體偏移；測釘局部鬆脫又可製造假收斂，若沒有絕對坐標便難以辨別兩者。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Both targets can translate together with unchanged chord length despite substantial section movement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用多條不共線弦與全測站坐標同時檢查，核對測釘是否牢固連到代表性支護；依設計預測方向比較位移向量，不用單一水平弦直接判定整個斷面均勻收縮。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：兩端測釘一起平移時弦長不變，卻可能已發生整體偏移；測釘局部鬆脫又可製造假收斂，若沒有絕對坐標便難以辨別兩者。
knowledge.textEn: Compare several noncollinear chords with total-station coordinates and check that targets represent stable support locations; compare vectors with predicted directions rather than inferring uniform section shrinkage from one horizontal chord. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Both targets can translate together with unchanged chord length despite substantial section movement. A loose target can instead create false convergence, difficult to distinguish without independent coordinates.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄收斂弦長與方向的資料來源與適用條件。用多條不共線弦與全測站坐標同時檢查，核對測釘是否牢固連到代表性支護；依設計預測方向比較位移向量，不用單一水平弦直接判定整個斷面均勻收縮。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for convergence chords and direction. Compare several noncollinear chords with total-station coordinates and check that targets represent stable support locations; compare vectors with predicted directions rather than inferring uniform section shrinkage from one horizontal chord.

quiz.question: 要驗證「收斂弦長與方向」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Convergence chords and direction"?
options: 用多條不共線弦與全測站坐標同時檢查，核對測釘是否牢固連到代表性支護；依設計預測方向比較位移向量，不用單一水平弦直接判定整個斷面均勻收縮。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
把斷面最佳擬合成圓就能保留全部橢圓化資訊。
optionsEn: Compare several noncollinear chords with total-station coordinates and check that targets represent stable support locations.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Fitting the section to a best-fit circle preserves all ovalization information.
quiz.explanation: 用多條不共線弦與全測站坐標同時檢查，核對測釘是否牢固連到代表性支護；依設計預測方向比較位移向量，不用單一水平弦直接判定整個斷面均勻收縮。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare several noncollinear chords with total-station coordinates and check that targets represent stable support locations; compare vectors with predicted directions rather than inferring uniform section shrinkage from one horizontal chord. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 收斂弦長與方向：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Convergence chords and direction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「收斂弦長與方向」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Convergence chords and direction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩端測釘一起平移時弦長不變，卻可能已發生整體偏移；測釘局部鬆脫又可製造假收斂，若沒有絕對坐標便難以辨別兩者。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Both targets can translate together with unchanged chord length despite substantial section movement. A loose target can instead create false convergence, difficult to distinguish without independent coordinates. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：兩端測釘一起平移時弦長不變，卻可能已發生整體偏移；測釘局部鬆脫又可製造假收斂，若沒有絕對坐標便難以辨別兩者。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A loose target can instead create false convergence, difficult to distinguish without independent coordinates.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩點間弦長不變就證明兩個測點都沒有移動。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An unchanged chord proves that neither of its endpoints has moved." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 兩端測釘一起平移時弦長不變，卻可能已發生整體偏移；測釘局部鬆脫又可製造假收斂，若沒有絕對坐標便難以辨別兩者。
knowledge.textEn: Both targets can translate together with unchanged chord length despite substantial section movement. A loose target can instead create false convergence, difficult to distinguish without independent coordinates.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「收斂弦長與方向」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Convergence chords and direction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
兩端測釘一起平移時弦長不變，卻可能已發生整體偏移；測釘局部鬆脫又可製造假收斂，若沒有絕對坐標便難以辨別兩者。
較晚安裝的測點記錄較小收斂，就表示該斷面更穩定。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Both targets can translate together with unchanged chord length despite substantial section movement.
Smaller convergence at a later-installed section proves that section is more stable.
quiz.explanation: 兩端測釘一起平移時弦長不變，卻可能已發生整體偏移；測釘局部鬆脫又可製造假收斂，若沒有絕對坐標便難以辨別兩者。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Both targets can translate together with unchanged chord length despite substantial section movement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 初始讀值與已發生變形：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Initial readings and prior movement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「初始讀值與已發生變形」如何影響隧道收斂量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Initial readings and prior movement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel convergence monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 量測只能看到首讀之後的變化，掌子面到達與裝設測點之間已發生的位移不在紀錄內。首讀里程、時間與支護狀態需一起保存，否則不同斷面會因量測起點不同而看似岩性差異。 假設首讀前已收斂6 mm、之後量得14 mm，總估計20 mm；缺失初期量占30%，須明列為推估。 晚裝測點的斷面可能看似變形最小而被判成最穩定，實際大部分已發生；以此降低支護會把量測時序偏差誤當地層改善。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「初始讀值與已發生變形」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Monitoring captures movement after the first reading, omitting displacement before installation. Preserve initial face distance, time and support state; otherwise different monitoring origins can masquerade as geological differences between sections. Assume 6 mm convergence before the first reading and 14 mm afterward; estimated total is 20 mm, with 30% explicitly inferred rather than measured. A late-installed section can appear most stable because much movement occurred before monitoring. Reducing support on that basis mistakes installation timing for improved ground conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Initial readings and prior movement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「較晚安裝的測點記錄較小收斂，就表示該斷面更穩定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Smaller convergence at a later-installed section proves that section is more stable." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「初始讀值與已發生變形」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Initial readings and prior movement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 初始讀值與已發生變形
knowledge.text: 量測只能看到首讀之後的變化，掌子面到達與裝設測點之間已發生的位移不在紀錄內。首讀里程、時間與支護狀態需一起保存，否則不同斷面會因量測起點不同而看似岩性差異。
knowledge.textEn: Monitoring captures movement after the first reading, omitting displacement before installation. Preserve initial face distance, time and support state; otherwise different monitoring origins can masquerade as geological differences between sections.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：較晚安裝的測點記錄較小收斂，就表示該斷面更穩定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Smaller convergence at a later-installed section proves that section is more stable. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「初始讀值與已發生變形」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Initial readings and prior movement" is correct?
options: 較晚安裝的測點記錄較小收斂，就表示該斷面更穩定。
全測站角度精度固定，所以位置誤差與觀測距離無關。
量測只能看到首讀之後的變化，掌子面到達與裝設測點之間已發生的位移不在紀錄內。
optionsEn: Smaller convergence at a later-installed section proves that section is more stable.
Fixed total-station angular precision makes positional error independent of sight distance.
Monitoring captures movement after the first reading, omitting displacement before installation.
quiz.explanation: 量測只能看到首讀之後的變化，掌子面到達與裝設測點之間已發生的位移不在紀錄內。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Monitoring captures movement after the first reading, omitting displacement before installation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 初始讀值與已發生變形：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Initial readings and prior movement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「初始讀值與已發生變形」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Initial readings and prior movement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設首讀前已收斂6 mm、之後量得14 mm，總估計20 mm；缺失初期量占30%，須明列為推估。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 6 mm convergence before the first reading and 14 mm afterward; estimated total is 20 mm, with 30% explicitly inferred rather than measured. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照開挖及支護日誌記錄首讀延遲，以相同面距或模型比較斷面；初期缺失量只能用經驗或分析給區間，不能回填成實測點，主管工程師需確認這種修正的用途。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record first-reading delay against excavation and support logs and compare sections at matching face distance or through a model; missing early movement receives an inferred interval, never fabricated measured points, with engineering approval of its use.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設首讀前已收斂6 mm、之後量得14 mm，總估計20 mm；缺失初期量占30%，須明列為推估。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 6 mm convergence before the first reading and 14 mm afterward; estimated total is 20 mm, with 30% explicitly inferred rather than measured.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「初始讀值與已發生變形」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Initial readings and prior movement", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
所有測點共同位移時，一定可以全部扣除當作基準漂移。
支護剛度乘位移可在有空隙未接觸時直接算出反力。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Common movement of all targets can always be subtracted as reference drift.
Support stiffness times movement directly gives reaction even before a gap closes.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 初始讀值與已發生變形：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Initial readings and prior movement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「初始讀值與已發生變形」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Initial readings and prior movement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照開挖及支護日誌記錄首讀延遲，以相同面距或模型比較斷面；初期缺失量只能用經驗或分析給區間，不能回填成實測點，主管工程師需確認這種修正的用途。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：晚裝測點的斷面可能看似變形最小而被判成最穩定，實際大部分已發生；以此降低支護會把量測時序偏差誤當地層改善。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record first-reading delay against excavation and support logs and compare sections at matching face distance or through a model; missing early movement receives an inferred interval, never fabricated measured points, with engineering approval of its use. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A late-installed section can appear most stable because much movement occurred before monitoring. Reducing support on that basis mistakes installation timing for improved ground conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄初始讀值與已發生變形的資料來源與適用條件。對照開挖及支護日誌記錄首讀延遲，以相同面距或模型比較斷面；初期缺失量只能用經驗或分析給區間，不能回填成實測點，主管工程師需確認這種修正的用途。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for initial readings and prior movement. Record first-reading delay against excavation and support logs and compare sections at matching face distance or through a model; missing early movement receives an inferred interval, never fabricated measured points, with engineering approval of its use.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：晚裝測點的斷面可能看似變形最小而被判成最穩定，實際大部分已發生；以此降低支護會把量測時序偏差誤當地層改善。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A late-installed section can appear most stable because much movement occurred before monitoring. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照開挖及支護日誌記錄首讀延遲，以相同面距或模型比較斷面；初期缺失量只能用經驗或分析給區間，不能回填成實測點，主管工程師需確認這種修正的用途。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：晚裝測點的斷面可能看似變形最小而被判成最穩定，實際大部分已發生；以此降低支護會把量測時序偏差誤當地層改善。
knowledge.textEn: Record first-reading delay against excavation and support logs and compare sections at matching face distance or through a model; missing early movement receives an inferred interval, never fabricated measured points, with engineering approval of its use. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A late-installed section can appear most stable because much movement occurred before monitoring. Reducing support on that basis mistakes installation timing for improved ground conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄初始讀值與已發生變形的資料來源與適用條件。對照開挖及支護日誌記錄首讀延遲，以相同面距或模型比較斷面；初期缺失量只能用經驗或分析給區間，不能回填成實測點，主管工程師需確認這種修正的用途。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for initial readings and prior movement. Record first-reading delay against excavation and support logs and compare sections at matching face distance or through a model; missing early movement receives an inferred interval, never fabricated measured points, with engineering approval of its use.

quiz.question: 要驗證「初始讀值與已發生變形」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Initial readings and prior movement"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
對照開挖及支護日誌記錄首讀延遲，以相同面距或模型比較斷面；初期缺失量只能用經驗或分析給區間，不能回填成實測點，主管工程師需確認這種修正的用途。
自動監測有持續更新的畫面就代表資料必定是最新值。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Record first-reading delay against excavation and support logs and compare sections at matching face distance or through a model.
A continuously updating automated display necessarily contains fresh measurements.
quiz.explanation: 對照開挖及支護日誌記錄首讀延遲，以相同面距或模型比較斷面；初期缺失量只能用經驗或分析給區間，不能回填成實測點，主管工程師需確認這種修正的用途。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record first-reading delay against excavation and support logs and compare sections at matching face distance or through a model; missing early movement receives an inferred interval, never fabricated measured points, with engineering approval of its use. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 初始讀值與已發生變形：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Initial readings and prior movement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「初始讀值與已發生變形」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Initial readings and prior movement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 晚裝測點的斷面可能看似變形最小而被判成最穩定，實際大部分已發生；以此降低支護會把量測時序偏差誤當地層改善。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A late-installed section can appear most stable because much movement occurred before monitoring. Reducing support on that basis mistakes installation timing for improved ground conditions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：晚裝測點的斷面可能看似變形最小而被判成最穩定，實際大部分已發生；以此降低支護會把量測時序偏差誤當地層改善。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Reducing support on that basis mistakes installation timing for improved ground conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「較晚安裝的測點記錄較小收斂，就表示該斷面更穩定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Smaller convergence at a later-installed section proves that section is more stable." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 晚裝測點的斷面可能看似變形最小而被判成最穩定，實際大部分已發生；以此降低支護會把量測時序偏差誤當地層改善。
knowledge.textEn: A late-installed section can appear most stable because much movement occurred before monitoring. Reducing support on that basis mistakes installation timing for improved ground conditions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「初始讀值與已發生變形」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Initial readings and prior movement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
全測站角度精度固定，所以位置誤差與觀測距離無關。
晚裝測點的斷面可能看似變形最小而被判成最穩定，實際大部分已發生；以此降低支護會把量測時序偏差誤當地層改善。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Fixed total-station angular precision makes positional error independent of sight distance.
A late-installed section can appear most stable because much movement occurred before monitoring.
quiz.explanation: 晚裝測點的斷面可能看似變形最小而被判成最穩定，實際大部分已發生；以此降低支護會把量測時序偏差誤當地層改善。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A late-installed section can appear most stable because much movement occurred before monitoring. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
